title: Puppy vaccination schedule
content: Puppies typically need their first round of core vaccines at 6-8 weeks, followed by boosters every 3-4 weeks until 16 weeks old. Book a Vaccination appointment to stay on schedule.

title: Kitten vaccination schedule
content: Kittens usually start core vaccines at 6-8 weeks with boosters every 3-4 weeks until about 16 weeks. Book a Vaccination appointment for your kitten's schedule.

title: Grooming frequency for dogs
content: Most dogs benefit from a Grooming Session every 4-6 weeks, though long-haired breeds may need it more often to prevent matting.

title: Grooming frequency for cats
content: Cats are largely self-grooming, but long-haired breeds benefit from a professional Grooming Session every 6-8 weeks to prevent matting and hairballs.

title: Hydration and hot weather
content: In Egypt's summer heat, make sure pets always have access to fresh water and shade. Watch for excessive panting or lethargy, which can indicate heat stress — this warrants a same-day check-up if severe.

title: Weight management
content: Obesity is common in pets and increases risk of joint and heart problems. A Medical Consultation can include a weight assessment and diet recommendations.
